notes.tile_template: Pure module web/src/shared/map/tileTemplate.ts. resolveTilePixelRatio(dpr): returns 1|2, @2x only when dpr>1.5 (dpr passed as param → deterministic in jsdom). buildTileUrl(template,key,ratio): injects {apikey}; ratio===2 swaps /256/ -> /256@2x/ (Mapy basic raster convention). CAVEAT: the exact @2x URL shape is best-effort per spec Section 4 and is not verifiable from a self-authored unit test alone — verify against Mapy docs in the WI-19 e2e tile render.
notes.mapy_map_api: web/src/shared/map/MapyMap.tsx. Props: { center?: [number,number]; zoom?: number; ariaLabel?: string; children?: ReactNode; doubleClickZoom?: boolean } plus MapContainer passthrough via rest. Consumes useGeoConfig() internally. center/zoom default to config.mapCenterLat/Lng/mapZoom when omitted; caller-supplied values override. MapContainer center/zoom are mount-time-only, so the map is NOT mounted until config resolves — a loading state (role=status, t('map.loading')) renders meanwhile, which doubles as graceful degradation when config errors (no crash, no blank mount on undefined center). Builds the Mapy TileLayer via buildTileUrl + resolveTilePixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio ?? 1). Attribution text passed to TileLayer; mandatory Mapy logo rendered as an accessible corner overlay anchor (NOT a Leaflet control) so it is keyboard-reachable and axe-testable. Imports './leafletSetup' for its icon-fix side effect (previously triggered by the OSM_* imports the components dropped).

notes.logo_asset_risk: OPEN RISK for WI-19 to visually confirm: MAPY_LOGO_URL='https://api.mapy.cz/img/api/logo.svg' is the documented Mapy REST API logo endpoint and matches spec Section 4 ('their SVG, linking to mapy.com'), but there is NO local Mapy logo asset in the repo (grep-verified: no web/**/*mapy* or public asset) and the backend MapyConstants carries only tile+attribution, no logo URL. The axe/link tests pass on alt+href+title even if that SVG 404s — so a broken logo image is invisible to vitest. WI-19's happy-path tile/attribution/logo render e2e must confirm the SVG actually loads; if it 404s, either the URL needs correcting or a local asset should be bundled.
